description_en: Deletes a high-availability virtual IP address (HaVip)
description_zh: 调用DeleteHaVip接口删除高可用虚拟IP（HaVip）
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-ha-vip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ha-vip-id havip-2zeo05qre24nhrqpy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteHaVip

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the HaVip. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: HaVip所在的地域。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HaVip that you want to delete
parameters.name: ha_vip_id
